articles.full_text: Sep 28, 2026 10:00am PT ‘Stillwater’: Amazon Series Based on Graphic Novel Casts Ben Hardy in Lead Role By Joe Otterson Plus Icon Joe Otterson TV Reporter joeotterson Latest ‘Icebreaker’ Netflix Series Casts Daisy Jelley, Connor Simos in Lead Roles (EXCLUSIVE) 4 hours ago Peter Sarsgaard Joins Kenneth Branagh in Paramount+ Series ‘Laird’ 3 days ago ‘Star Trek: Strange New Worlds’ Star Celia Rose Gooding Breaks Down That Time-Jumping Season 4 Finale 4 days ago See All IONA WOLFF Ben Hardy is set to star in the series adaptation of the graphic novel “ Stillwater ” at Amazon Prime Video , Variety has learned. The series is based on the Skybound graphic novel of the same name and was greenlit at Amazon back in July. The streamer has given the one-hour show an eight-episode order. The official logline states the show is a “mind-bending horror thriller that focuses on ex-con Daniel West (Hardy). When Daniel receives a mysterious letter promising answers about his past and a substantial inheritance in the small town of Stillwater, he discovers a community where nothing ever ages, no one ever dies, and nobody ever gets out.” Related Stories Major TV Networks Suspend White House Pool Coverage of Trump in Protest of His CNN Ban ‘60 Minutes’ Notches Ratings Gain Over Last Year, but Cedes Viewers From Season Premiere “We’ve been fans of Ben’s for a long time, and we’re thrilled to get to tell this story together,” said series writers and executive producers Greg Berlanti and Carly Wray. “There’s a toughness to him, but also something incredibly open and soulful underneath it. Daniel needs both. From the moment we saw Ben in the role, it was impossible to imagine anyone else.” Popular on Variety Hardy is known for his roles in films like “The Conjuring: Last Rites,” “Bohemian Rhapsody,” “6 Underground,” “Only the Brave,” and “X-Men: Apocalypse.” He has also starred in shows like “The Girl Before,” “The Woman in White,” and “EastEnders.” He is repped by UTA, Principal Entertainment LA and Independent Talent Group. The “Stillwater” graphic novel was created by Chip Zdarsky and Ramón K Pérez. Wray and Berlanti co-wrote the pilot episode and executive produce, with Berlanti doing so via Berlanti Productions. Sarah Schechter, Leigh London Redman, and Robbie Rogers of Berlanti Productions also executive produce along with Robert Kirkman, David Alpert, Rick Jacobs, Glenn Geller, and Zdarsky for Skybound Entertainment. Jonathan Gabay also serves as an executive producer. Warner Bros. Television and Amazon MGM Studios will produce. Berlanti and Wray are both under overall deals at WBTV. articles.title: Amazon to Develop ‘Shadow Work’ Series Based on Adrienne Miller Short Story, Marc Resteghini to Produce (EXCLUSIVE)
articles.full_text: Sep 28, 2026 10:15am PT Amazon to Develop ‘Shadow Work’ Series Based on Adrienne Miller Short Story, Marc Resteghini to Produce (EXCLUSIVE) By Joe Otterson Plus Icon Joe Otterson TV Reporter joeotterson Latest ‘Stillwater’: Amazon Series Based on Graphic Novel Casts Ben Hardy in Lead Role 16 minutes ago ‘Icebreaker’ Netflix Series Casts Daisy Jelley, Connor Simos in Lead Roles (EXCLUSIVE) 4 hours ago Peter Sarsgaard Joins Kenneth Branagh in Paramount+ Series ‘Laird’ 3 days ago See All Getty Images In a competitive situation, Amazon MGM Studios is set to develop a series based on the short story “Shadow Work” by Adrienne Miller, Variety has learned exclusively from sources. Miller will write the pilot for the one-hour series and serve as executive producer. Former Amazon exec Marc Resteghini will executive produce via Jack Tar Pictures, which has an overall deal at Amazon MGM Studios. According to sources, the producers fielded multiple offers before Amazon preemptively acquired it. Related Stories ‘60 Minutes’ Kicks Off Much-Scrutinized 59th Season With Old Ticks and Tricks ‘48 Hours’ Expands Use of Video Podcasting With 'Woman in the Woods' Reps for Amazon declined to comment. Popular on Variety The logline for the show states that it follows Genevieve Pearce, “an elite ghostwriter trusted with the secrets of the rich, famous, and infamous. She embeds in their worlds, excavates secrets, reshapes memories, manufactures redemption, and transforms the powerful into the people they want the world to believe they are. Because in Genevieve’s world, whoever controls the story controls reality. But as she rewrites everyone else’s stories, she’s forced to confront the first story she ever helped rewrite: her own.” Miller is the author of the novel “The Coast of Akron” as well as the memoir “In the Land of Men,” in which she describes her rise through the male-dominated magazine world to become the first female literary editor at Esquire. During her time at Esquire, the publication won the National Magazine Award for fiction. Miller is also a frequent contributor to Vogue. She is repped by Gersh and Yorn Levine. Resteghini is currently an executive producer on the Amazon series “Young Sherlock,” which received a Season 2 renewal in April . His current slate includes an animated series adaptation of the Tui T. Sutherland “Wings of Fire” books, a feature adaptation of the upcoming Lauren Oliver novel “The Girl in the Lake” in partnership with United Artists, and a series inspired by the lyrics and characters of Billy Joel’s songbook from creator David Weil and MGM Television. Prior to launching his own production banner, Resteghini was a senior creative executive at Amazon for nearly a decade. articles.title: Carrie Coon Set to Receive Vancouver’s First Luminary Award (EXCLUSIVE)
articles.full_text: Sep 28, 2026 10:15am PT Carrie Coon Set to Receive Vancouver’s First Luminary Award (EXCLUSIVE) Other Luminary Award recipients are Markus Schleinzer and Leah Nelson as VIFF unveils a wide-ranging program of talks, panels and masterclasses By Katherine Brodsky Plus Icon Katherine Brodsky Latest Vancouver Film Festival Reveals 2026 Lineup: Jesse Eisenberg, Cristian Mungiu but Also Local Talent, Indigenous and Nonfiction Cinema 4 weeks ago Green Screen: British Columbia Adopts More Sustainability Practices for Production Shoots 2 years ago Telefilm Canada Focuses on Finding Fresh Voices But Faces Financing Roadblocks 3 years ago See All Fabio Lovino/HBO Carrie Coon will be the first recipient of the Vancouver International Film Festival’s new Luminary Award in the acting category, honoring excellence and dedication to the art of moving image. The “White Lotus,” “The Gilded Age,” and “The Leftovers” star is set to take part in a wide-ranging conversation following the Oct. 4 presentation. Coon also stars in “The Liberation,” which screens earlier that day at VIFF, playing a mother trying to escape the weight of her harrowing past, only to find solace in an all-women’s cult. Related Stories ‘60 Minutes’ Notches Ratings Gain Over Last Year, but Cedes Viewers From Season Premiere Major TV Networks Suspend White House Pool Coverage of Trump in Protest of His CNN Ban Beyond Coon’s appearance, VIFF’s Oct. 1-11 program will feature talks, panels and masterclasses bringing filmmakers, craftspeople, producers, programmers and other industry professionals to Vancouver. The festival will also present Luminary Awards to Markus Schleinzer (“Rose”) for directing excellence and Leah Nelson (“Tangles”) for screenwriting. Popular on Variety The festival’s VIFF Talks series kicks off Oct. 3 with editor Matthew Hannam , whose recent credits include Halina Reijn’s “Babygirl” and Noah Baumbach’s “White Noise.” Hannam, who will be discussing his collaborative approach, began his career as an assistant editor in Winnipeg, working with Canadian auteurs like Guy Maddin. Producer Haley Johnson will discuss the making of “Obsession,” the independently produced film made on a shoestring budget that went on to gross over $500 million worldwide. The Oct. 4 conversation will focus on the film’s production and subsequent trajectory, including a studio bidding war following its Toronto premiere. On Oct. 5, production designers Brandon Tonner-Connolly and Matt Hyland will discuss working together to build the surreal, immersive world of Jane Schoenbrun’s “Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma.” The VIFF Talks series concludes Oct. 7 with Mark Mothersbaugh , DEVO co-founder and composer behind Wes Anderson’s “Rushmore,” “The Royal Tenenbaums” and “The Life Aquatic with Steve Zissou,” amongst others. He’ll be in conversation with composer and former Fox studio exec Robert Kraft. This year’s masterclass programming has a distinctly international flavor. Guests include Latvian producer, writer and director Matīss Kaža , who co-wrote and produced Gints Zilbalodis’ “Flow,” which won the Academy Award for animated feature last year. Chilean producer Giancarlo Nasi , whose credits include “The Mysterious Gaze of the Flamingo,” winner of the Grand Prix at Cannes’ Un Certain Regard n 2025, will lead a session on international co-productions. Berlin-based film editor Evelyn Rack — behind the Cannes Jury Prize winner and Germany’s Oscars submission, “Sound of Falling” — will lead “Editing as Discovery: Narrative, Instinct, and the Unpredictable.” And Barcelona-born, Berlin-based audience designer Isona Admetlla will explore audience strategy and creative distribution. The panel lineup, meanwhile, brings together figures from across the festival and distribution ecosystem. “Curating Cinema in a Shifting Landscape” will feature Pamela Biénzobas , a programmer at the Locarno Film Festival, alongside VIFF documentary programmer Ruun Nuur and critic/programmer Saffron Maeve , for a discussion of how film curation is evolving. “From Festival to Marketplace: Meet the Decision Makers” will bring together Michael Robson of Elevation Pictures, Max Collister of Mubi Canada and Richelle Charkot of Game Theory Films to discuss the path from festival exposure to distribution and audiences. The Vancouver-to-international trajectory will be the focus of “From Vancouver to the World: The Making of Tangles,” featuring director Leah Nelson alongside several members of the creative team behind the animated feature. Based on Vancouver artist Sarah Leavitt’s graphic memoir, “Tangles” was selected for Cannes the best first feature Caméra d’Or at Cannes and boasts a voice cast that includes Abbi Jacobson, Julia Louis-Dreyfus, Bryan Cranston, and Seth Rogen. Other panels will examine Indigenous filmmaking and narrative sovereignty, deal-making, documentary filmmaking beyond certainty, and the craft of comedy. The festival will also showcase its Composer Filmmaker Accelerator, an initiative connecting emerging composers with filmmakers through mentorship and hands-on collaboration. It is curated by three-time Emmy-nominated composer Miriam Cutler , whose credits include “RBG,” “Love Gilda,” and “Lost in La Mancha.” The 2026 CFA showcase takes place Oct. 8. Among the filmmakers and industry figures also expected at VIFF are Canadian icon Rick Hansen , actor and “School for Defectors” producer Daniel Dae Kim , and Canadian directors Matthew Rankin (“Ladies and Gentlemen, Brian Mulroney”), Marie Clements (“How We Stand,” “Reclaim My Skin”) and Zach Lipovsky (“Freaks Part II”). articles.title: ‘Kid Detective’ Series Adaptation in the Works at Hulu (EXCLUSIVE)
articles.full_text: Sep 28, 2026 10:30am PT ‘Kid Detective’ Series Adaptation in the Works at Hulu (EXCLUSIVE) Evan Morgan will executive produce, with Rachel Kaplan exec producing via Abescon Entertainment By Joe Otterson Plus Icon Joe Otterson TV Reporter joeotterson Latest Amazon to Develop ‘Shadow Work’ Series Based on Adrienne Miller Short Story, Marc Resteghini to Produce (EXCLUSIVE) 15 minutes ago ‘Stillwater’: Amazon Series Based on Graphic Novel Casts Ben Hardy in Lead Role 30 minutes ago ‘Icebreaker’ Netflix Series Casts Daisy Jelley, Connor Simos in Lead Roles (EXCLUSIVE) 4 hours ago See All ©Sony Pictures/Courtesy Everett Collection Hulu is developing a series version of the 2020 movie “The Kid Detective,” Variety has learned exclusively. Evan Morgan, who wrote and directed the film, is attached as an executive producer on the project. Alex Berger will write and executive produce. Rachel Kaplan of Abescon Entertainment will also executive produce, with Jonathan Bronfman and Will Woods — who produced the film — producing the series as well. Adam Brody, who starred in “The Kid Detective,” is not attached at this time. Related Stories ‘60 Minutes’ Kicks Off Much-Scrutinized 59th Season With Old Ticks and Tricks ‘48 Hours’ Expands Use of Video Podcasting With 'Woman in the Woods' The logline for the series states, “When a missing persons case reopens the childhood murder he never solved, a washed-up former kid detective gets one last shot at proving his best days aren’t behind him.” Popular on Variety Brody starred as the titular kid detective Abe Applebaum in the film, which debuted at TIFF in 2020. The film was well-received by critics upon its release. In his review for Variety , Tomris Laffly wrote “Splendidly summoning film noir-esque vibes, classically ghastly bad guys and femme fatale types out of a whimsical small town full of grotesque mysteries, this bold and often surprisingly humorous film…grapples with themes related to murder and abuse, as well as the existential dread of its central recluse, who fell grossly short of the promising life he thought he was meant to have in his younger days.” Berger most recently worked on “CIA” at CBS as well as shows like “The Perfect Couple” at Netflix and “Quantum Leap” for NBC. His other credits include “Blindspot,” “The Mentalist,” “Franklin & Bash,” and “Glenn Martin DDS.” Kaplan was previously head of scripted TV at Keshet Studios before launching Abescon studios in 2020. Under that banner, she has executive produced shows like “La Brea” at NBC and has projects in active development across a range of streamers and networks. During her time with Keshet, she shephered shows like “The Baker and the Beauty,” “Lincoln Rhyme: The Hunt for the Bone Collector,” And “Wisdom of the Crowd.” Berger is repped by UTA, A.B. Fischer, and Yorn Levine. Morgan is repped by Range and Verve. articles.title: Fox News To Launch ‘The Girls’ Podcast With Network Personalities And Others As Rotating Co-Hosts
articles.full_text: Continue to Deadline SKIP AD You will be redirected back to your article in seconds Skip to main content By Ted Johnson Ted Johnson Political Editor @tedstew More Stories By Ted Fox News To Launch ‘The Girls’ Podcast With Network Personalities And Others As Rotating Co-Hosts Harry Smith To Return To NBC News As A Contributor ‘Saturday Night Live’ Opens Season With Riff On Donald Trump’s Need For More Time With Zohran Mamdani: “Please Let Me Stay Here With You” View All September 28, 2026 9:00am Fox News is launching The Girls , a conversation series for its podcast division that will feature a rotating series of co-hosts each week. The first episode will debut on Thursday, with new episodes dropping that day each week. The conversations will delve into pop culture, parenting, relationships, careers, money and politics. The first episode will feature network personalities Rachel Campos-Duffy , Harris Faulkner and Kat Timpf, new contributor Melissa DeRosa and former ESPN host Samantha Ponder. Fox News Podcasts has expanded its portfolio, debuting Hang Out with Sean Hannity earlier this year. This latest podcast is the latest iteration of a panel format that has worked well for the network, including with The Five and Outnumbered. Campos-Duffy co-hosts Fox & Friends Weekend , and joined the network in 2016. Faulkner, with Fox News since 2005, anchors The Faulkner Focus and co-hosts Outnumbered . Timpf is a panelist on Gutfeld! , and joined the network in 2015. DeRosa previously served in the administration of New York Governor Andrew Cuomo. Ponder formerly hosted ESPN’s Sunday Countdown . Watch on Deadline Porter Berry, president of Fox News Digital and New Media, called the show “a natural addition to our growing podcast portfolio.” Megan Albano, executive vice president of morning programming and program development, said in a statement that the podcast would be a “no-holds-barred format that captures the authenticity and perspectives of the many dynamic women” on the network and elsewhere. articles.title: Ohio House of Horrors Doc Set At Oxygen
articles.full_text: Continue to Deadline SKIP AD You will be redirected back to your article in seconds Skip to main content By Peter White Peter White Executive Editor, Television @peterzwhite More Stories By Peter ‘SNL’s Weekend Update Mocks Paramount+, ‘Spider-Man’, ‘The Odyssey’ & ‘Obsession’ ‘SNL’ Season 52 Premiere Delayed In Many Areas Due To College Football ‘SNL’ Promotes Keri Powers & Rebecca Schwartz View All September 28, 2026 9:00am Oxygen EXCLUSIVE : In June, in rural Ohio, 16 children, from toddlers to teenagers were found living in a 12×12 room in conditions so deplorable that authorities described it as “pure evil”. This story is set to be explored in a new feature-length documentary for Oxygen . The Versant-owned cable network has greenlit The Siders 16: Ohio House of Horrors (w/t) from KT Studios , the company behind Amazon’s Murder 101 and Peacock’s The Idaho Student Murders. The Siders 16: Ohio House of Horrors will explore the case as it unfolds in real time after the children’s parents Gary Siders Jr. and Elizabeth Siders, and their grandparents, Gary Siders Sr. and Christina Siders, were arrested at the scene. Related Stories Cancellations and Renewals Lisa Vanderpump To Host 'Snapped' Spinoff 'Rich Bitch Rampage' For Oxygen As Part Of Versant Slate News Inside Versant's Content Strategy: True-Crime, A.I., Recognizable Drama IP & More Reality Shows With Wrestlers The group were charged were multiple counts of endangering children, while, in August, Gary Siders Jr. and Elizabeth were also charged with allegations of child sexual abuse in a separate case. Watch on Deadline The film will touch on these unexpected new charges and ask: Who ultimately bears responsibility for what happened to these children? The 90-minute doc will premiere later this year on Oxygen True Crime. It follows the success of The Hooters Murders: Deadly Shift, which was Oxygen’s most-watched doc premiere in more than two years. The Siders 16: Ohio House of Horrors is directed by KT Studios founder Stephanie Lydecker, who also exec produces alongside Kevin Brennecke. Alongside the doc, the network will also launch its first-ever companion podcast series. The ten-part audio series will be available on all major podcast platforms as well as Oxygen’s digital platforms. articles.title: ‘Wildwood’ Studio Laika Is First Honoree For This Year’s Gotham Film Awards
articles.full_text: Continue to Deadline SKIP AD You will be redirected back to your article in seconds Skip to main content By Patrick Hipes Patrick Hipes Executive Managing Editor More Stories By Patrick Santa Barbara Film Festival Awards: ‘Wild Horse Nine’ Star John Malkovich To Get Performer Of The Year Honor ‘Madden’ Trailer: Boom! Nicolas Cage Transforms In David O. Russell’s Biopic Of NFL Icon ‘Wild Horse Nine’ Trailer: Martin McDonagh’s Venice Hit Saddles Up For Awards-Season Run View All September 28, 2026 9:00am 'Wildwood' Laika EXCLUSIVE: Laika , the animation studio that has scored six Oscar nominations for its stop-motion films including Coraline, ParaNorman, The Boxtrolls and Kubo and Two Strings since its founding in 2005, will be honored with the Gotham Anniversary Tribute at this year’s Gotham Film Awards . The tribute commemorates Laika’s 20 years of storytelling and the release of Wildwood , its newest film, which hits theaters October 23 via Fathom Entertainment. The pic will have its world premiere at the London Film Festival October 11 and 10 days later serve as the opening-night film at AFI Fest . Related Stories Trailers Laika Unveils Final Trailer For Latest Stop-Motion Fantasy Adventure ‘Wildwood’ Below The Line 2026-27 Awards Season Calendar: Oscars, Emmys, Grammys, Guilds & More It marks the first tribute award revealed for the 36th annual Gothams, put on by the Gotham Film & Media Institute, which take place this year November 20 at Cipriani Wall Street in New York City. Watch on Deadline “After 20 years of pushing the boundaries of modern cinema and animation, this moment feels like both a celebration and an evolution for Laika,” said Jeffrey Sharp, executive director of the institute, which earlier this year teamed with the animation studio to launch Laika x Gotham Animation Accelerator for creators working on animated short films. “With Wildwood , Laika’s most ambitious film to date, and the launch of Laika Live Action opening up new creative territory, the studio continues to expand the possibilities of what handcrafted storytelling can be. We can think of no more fitting honoree for this year’s Anniversary Tribute, and we’re thrilled to welcome the Laika team to celebrate with us.” Travis Knight, Laika’s president and CEO, directs Wildwood , which was written by Chris Butler based on Colin Meloy’s novel. It centers on headstrong teenager Prue McKeel (Peyton Elizabeth Lee), who after her baby brother is abducted by a murder of crows launches with her hapless but loyal classmate Curtis Mehlberg (Jacob Tremblay) a rescue mission into the Impassable Wilderness — an enchanted forest hidden just beyond Portland, OR. It voice cast also includes Carey Mulligan, Mahershala Ali, Angela Bassett, Awkwafina, Jake Johnson, Charlie Day, Amandla Stenberg, Jemaine Clement, Maya Erskine, Tantoo Cardinal, Tom Waits and Richard E. Grant. “We’re deeply honored that The Gotham is recognizing Laika at a moment when we’re celebrating two decades of filmmaking and bringing Wildwood to audiences,” said David Burke, Laika’s Chief Marketing & Operations Officer. “Our partnership on the Laika x Gotham Animation Accelerator reflects something we care deeply about: creating meaningful opportunities for bold new voices to push animation forward. We’re grateful to The Gotham for this recognition and for a partnership grounded in a shared belief in original, ambitious storytelling.” More Gotham tributes will be rolled out throughout the fall, with nominations in the 10 competition Gotham Awards categories to be revealed October 27. articles.title: ‘Minions & Monsters’ Sets Peacock Release Date
articles.full_text: Continue to Deadline SKIP AD You will be redirected back to your article in seconds Skip to main content By Denise Petski Denise Petski Senior Managing Editor More Stories By Denise ‘Minions & Monsters’ Sets Peacock Release Date ‘Icebreaker’ Netflix Series Casts Daisy Jelley & Connor Simos As Stassie & Nate ‘The Last Of Us’ Casts John Goodman, Ian Alexander & Laura Bailey For Season 3 View All September 28, 2026 9:00am 'Minions & Monsters' (2026) Universal Pictures/Courtesy Everett Collection Minions & Monsters will begin streaming on Peacock on October 28, following its July 1 theatrical release. Starring Pierre Coffin, Allison Janney, Christoph Waltz, Jesse Eisenberg, Jeff Bridges and Zoey Deutch, the seventh installment in the Despicable Me franchise and third in the Minions prequel series is set in 1920s Hollywood. As Deadline’s Damon Wise noted in his review, the opening credits alone trace the history of the Universal logo back to the silent-era days of The Trans-Atlantic Film Company. Per the synopsis, the Illumination /Universal film tells “the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story” of how the Minions — led by Dick — conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created. Related Stories News Universal Becomes First Studio To Pass $5 Billion At Year-To-Date Global Box Office News 'Musk': Was Universal Getting Cold Feet Over Releasing Alex Gibney Doc? The latest installment is directed by Oscar nominee Pierre Coffin, who helmed the first three Despicable Me films and the first Minions movie. Coffin also provides the voice of the Minions in the film, which he has done since the characters’ film debut in 2010. Watch on Deadline Brian Lynch ( Minions , The Secret Life of Pets films) and Coffin wrote the screenplay, which is produced by Illumination’s Oscar-nominated founder and CEO Chris Meledandri and Bill Ryan ( The Super Mario Bros. Movie) . Lynch also is an EP. Minions & Monsters was a box office success, grossing $524 million worldwide and becoming the ninth-highest-grossing globally for 2026. Created 15 years ago, the Minions have boosted Illumination’s Despicable Me and Minions to a global box office of more than $5.6 billion. The previous Minions film, 2022’s Minions: The Rise of Gru , was a summer tentpole, earning almost $1 billion worldwide. articles.title: Shawn Levy Moves To Disney’s 20th Television With Overall Deal After Long Tenure At Netflix
articles.full_text: Continue to Deadline SKIP AD You will be redirected back to your article in seconds Skip to main content By Nellie Andreeva Nellie Andreeva Editor-In-Chief @DeadlineNellie More Stories By Nellie Shawn Levy Moves To Disney’s 20th Television With Overall Deal After Long Tenure At Netflix ‘Scrubs’ Zach Braff Gives Discouraging Ken Jenkins Return Update, Teases More Dr. Cox, Turk Mental Health Arc In Season 2 ‘Scrubs’ Stars On How Scott Foley & Rachel Bilson’s Arrival Changes J.D. & Elliot’s Relationship & Impacts Turk’s Marriage View All September 28, 2026 9:32am Shawn Levy Guy Aroch With Stranger Things coming to an end, both series’ creators/executive producers The Duffer Brothers and director/executive producer Shawn Levy are moving on by setting up shop elsewhere. Following the Duffer Brothers’ massive film and TV overall deal at Paramount , Levy and his 21 Laps Entertainment have signed a big multi-year overall deal with 20th Television , a part of Disney Television Studios, where he will develop and produce series across Disney Entertainment’s portfolio of platforms and brands. Related Stories News Duffer Brothers Close 4-Year Film, TV & Streaming Megadeal With Paramount, Set Netflix Exit News ‘La Bola Negra’ Trailer: Latest Look At TIFF’s People’s Choice Winner, Spain’s Oscar Entry & Cannes Breakout Over the past few months, 20th TV has been able to attract top talent from multiple rival studios, signing overall deals with Abbott Elementary ‘s Quinta Brunson, who was at Warner Bros. TV, The Five Star Weekend EP Sue Naegle, who was at Universal, and now Levy. Watch on Deadline “Shawn has a rare ability to tell stories that are wildly entertaining and deeply human, something he’s brought to Disney across two decades,” said Dana Walden, Disney’s President and Chief Creative Office. “He moves effortlessly across genres and franchises with a remarkable sense of what captures audiences and inspires passionate fandom. He’s an incredible storyteller and a true creative partner of the highest caliber, and we are thrilled to be building this next chapter together.” Disney and Levy have an ongoing relationship on the feature side, which may have factored into his decision to also move his TV business there. He directed and co-wrote Marvel Studios’ blockbuster Deadpool & Wolverine and is directing Lucasfilm’s upcoming Star Wars: Starfighter, starring Ryan Gosling. He is also re-teaming with Gosling on Marvel Studios’ Ghost Rider movie. Early in his career, Levy directed the Disney Channel series The Famous Jett Jackson and later produced Alexander and the Terrible, Horrible, No Good, Very Bad Day for Walt Disney Pictures. “Years before I directed movies, I started my career directing and producing television episodes for Disney Channel, and I’ve always felt a kindred spirit in Disney and their storytelling ethos,” Levy said. “Having worked with Dana Walden over the years when we were both at Fox, I know her to be a formidable, smart and authentic person, not to mention a force of nature as an executive. Coupled with the amazing Debra OConnell, Disney Television has such an exciting era ahead, and I’m enthusiastic and inspired to produce the next wave of 21 Laps television series with the entire Disney team. I know from experience the passionate creative DNA of this place, and it honestly just feels like home.” Levy also acknowledged the leadership at Netflix where he spent more than a decade. “I will forever cherish the incredible ride 21 Laps has had with Netflix,” he said. “I am deeply grateful to Ted, Bela, Jinny and the many talented Netflix execs with whom we have worked over the years and, of course, look forward to continuing our collaboration on the Stranger Things universe from the Duffer Brothers.” The animated Stranger Things: Tales From ’85 just returned for a second season with at least one other offshoot series waiting for a green light at Netflix. Previously, Levy directed 20th Century Studios’ Free Guy , the multi-film franchise The Night at the Museum and Cheaper by the Dozen. articles.title: White House Defends Using Taxpayer Money To Run Trump Ad — Even Though It’s Nearly The Same As 2024 Campaign Spot
articles.full_text: Continue to Deadline SKIP AD You will be redirected back to your article in seconds Skip to main content By Ted Johnson Ted Johnson Political Editor @tedstew More Stories By Ted Fox News To Launch ‘The Girls’ Podcast With Network Personalities And Others As Rotating Co-Hosts Harry Smith Returning To NBC News As A Contributor ‘Saturday Night Live’ Opens Season With Riff On Donald Trump’s Need For More Time With Zohran Mamdani: “Please Let Me Stay Here With You” View All September 28, 2026 9:35am Screenshot of taxpayer-funded Donald Trump ad The Trump White House is defending spending taxpayer dollars to run a series of ads that have drawn criticism on both sides of the aisle as they resemble campaign spots. In fact, an ad featuring Trump that ran over the weekend is nearly the same as one that he posted on social media in 2023, as he was campaigning for a return to the presidency. The ad that ran over the weekend features the message, “Paid for by the U.S. Government.” The spot he posted in 2023 features the Trump campaign logo. In the spot from the weekend and from his campaign, Trump says that “this is the final battle. With you at my side, we will demolish the deep state. We will expel the warmongers from our government. We will drive out the globalists. We will cast out the communists, marxists and fascists. We will throw off the sick political class that hates our country. We will rout the fake news media and we will liberate America from these villains, once and for all.” Watch on Deadline Related Stories News Fox News To Launch 'The Girls' Podcast With Network Personalities And Others As Rotating Co-Hosts News Harry Smith To Return To NBC News As A Contributor Steven Cheung, White House communications director, posted on X on Sunday, “Don’t let the Fake News get away with their lies about our epic Public Service Announcements that have been running on tv.” But there has been criticism from both parties. Sen. John Kennedy (R-LA) said that “you can’t spend public money to promote yourself.” He added that “I may end up with a sombrero on my head, but I also think that we ought to have a rule that no politician can have a building named after him while he’s alive.” Kennedy’s reference to a sombrero was to Trump pushing out a deepfake video last fall of House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries. Trump also has sought to put his name on the Kennedy Center, even though Congress designated it as a memorial to the late president. Rep. Thomas Massie (R-KY) posted on X, “Don’t worry, using taxpayer dollars to run ominous campaign ads of the President has been done before and is completely legal… in banana republics.” About $319,000 has been spent on the spot, according to the AP, citing estimates from AdImpact. Two other spots began running last week. The White House sent out a release on Friday contending that the spots “are very clearly not campaign ads; President Trump is not on the ballot and there is no call to action. Instead, the announcements are a reminder for Americans to love their country and know why it’s worth defending — at home, at the border, and abroad.” Federal law bars appropriations from being used for “publicity or propaganda” purposes, but there has been some leeway for the use of taxpayer money for public service announcements on specific issues. The White House pointed to spots by the Obama administration to promote the Affordable Care Act and the Biden administration to spread the word about the Covid vaccine. But the latest Trump spot is centered on Trump himself, not a single issue, and largely mirrors the previous campaign ad . Margaret Dylus-Yukins, legal counsel for ethics at the Campaign Legal Center, said in a statement, “Federal law prohibits taxpayer resources from being used for the benefit of a candidate, political party or public official. These ads almost entirely revolve around President Trump, who is not a candidate, but who has told voters to act as if he is on the ballot in November. The latest ad is a complete republication of a 2024 Trump campaign ad, and the earlier ad echoes themes and messages that Republicans are pushing this election; neither has any apparent connection to any federal program or service.” She added, “At a minimum, this is an appalling abuse of taxpayer dollars, particularly when hundreds of millions of private dollars are already flowing into U.S. elections—and Trump has personally helped raise enormous sums from wealthy special interests for a super PAC devoted to advancing his political agenda.” The U.S. Government is up on TV with this spot — It aired nationally on FOX yesterday during Illinois at #7 Ohio State and also during Fox News Sunday this morning pic.twitter.com/8PP9FPzUZk — Medium Buying (@MediumBuying) September 27, 2026 Shawn Levy Moves To Disney’s 20th Television With Overall Deal After Netflix Stint Taylor Swift Debuts New Music Video; Winners List; Red Carpet Photos ‘Endgame’ Reissue Assembles $26M In No. 2 Late-September Frame Ever New Cuts Hit Tech Unit; Analysis Of What’s Going On With Pubcaster’s Funding Read More About: 1 Comments

articles.title: BBC Tech Teams Hit With Fresh $50M Round Of Cuts, Including 110 Compulsory Layoffs
articles.full_text: Continue to Deadline SKIP AD You will be redirected back to your article in seconds Skip to main content By Jake Kanter Jake Kanter International Investigations Editor @Jake_Kanter More Stories By Jake Analysis: What The Heck Is Going On With The BBC’s Funding? ‘Harry Potter’ Producer David Barron Backs AI Adaptation Of ‘The Call Of The Wild’ BBC Boss Matt Brittin On Expected Service Closures: “No Program Or Channel Will Exist Forever” View All September 28, 2026 9:48am BBC series 'Strictly Come Dancing' Guy Levy/BBC EXCLUSIVE : The cuts keep coming at the BBC . BBC Media Tech, the division that powers the UK broadcaster’s online services like iPlayer , has today announced a fresh £37 million ($50M) round of savings after delivering £42M of cuts earlier this year. Around 110 staff in the unit will face compulsory redundancy, while 35 vacancies will be closed. The BBC expects to make a further 180 Media Tech layoffs through voluntary redundancy, which includes the 150 Deadline reported on last week . This will not be the last of the cuts, either. Kelly Kowal, the BBC chief operations and portfolio officer, told staff in an email that Media Tech will need to find an additional £23M of savings in early 2027. Watch on Deadline Related Stories News BBC Boss Matt Brittin On Expected Service Closures: "No Program Or Channel Will Exist Forever" News International Insider: Deep BBC Cuts Begin; Ali G Under Fire; San Sebastian Report The BBC Media Tech cuts follow similar savings announcements in BBC Sport and local radio. Deadline also revealed last week that channel closures are imminent , with insiders expecting BBC Three to be moved online for a second time in a decade. BBC Media Tech will contribute £102M of savings to the corporation’s overall target of £500M, which the BBC must deliver because of the growing number of Brits who are refusing to pay for the licence fee. The BBC tech division will embrace AI to reduce costs, according to Kowal. The unit is also expected to focus on fewer products and push more resource into boosting iPlayer. Matt Brittin, the BBC director general, has been candid about the need to improve iPlayer recommendations and user experience. Kowal told employees: “I want to recognise the uncertainty and worry this news will create, particularly those potentially affected by redundancy or worried about their role. There is no easy way to make these choices, but we will be caring, respectful and considered in how we help people work through their options.” Shawn Levy Moves To Disney’s 20th Television With Overall Deal After Netflix Stint Taylor Swift Debuts New Music Video; Winners List; Red Carpet Photos ‘Endgame’ Reissue Assembles $26M In No. 2 Late-September Frame Ever New Cuts Hit Tech Unit; Analysis Of What’s Going On With Pubcaster’s Funding Read More About: 3 Comments

Stillwater is a mind-bending horror thriller that focuses on ex-con Daniel West. When Daniel receives a mysterious letter promising answers about his past and a substantial inheritance in the small town of Stillwater, he discovers a community where nothing ever ages, no one ever dies, and nobody ever gets out. articles.title: Lindsay Lohan & Henry Golding To Lead Netflix Romantic Feature ‘Return To You’ From Director Mark Waters
articles.full_text: Continue to Deadline SKIP AD You will be redirected back to your article in seconds Skip to main content By Rosy Cordero Rosy Cordero Associate Editor, TV @SocialRosy More Stories By Rosy Tamera Mowry-Housley To Guest Star On ‘Scrubs’ Season 2 Mekki Leeper Workplace Comedy Set In World Of Private Equity Ordered To Series By Prime Video Seth Meyers Developing New Workplace Comedy ‘The Game Room’ At NBC View All September 28, 2026 10:00am Lindsay Lohan and Henry Golding Miles Diggs/Melissa Dezarate EXCLUSIVE: Lindsay Lohan ( Mean Girls , Freaky Friday ) is set to produce and star in the new Netflix romantic feature Return to You , starring opposite Henry Golding ( Crazy Rich Asians , Last Christmas) . Mark Waters , who directed Lohan in Freaky Friday and Mean Girls , will direct Return to You . She will also re-team with Brad Krevoy, producer of Netflix’s Falling for Christmas and Irish Wish , who will produce. From screenwriter Eric Champnella, Return to You follows a powerful but lonely female attorney (Lohan) who mistakenly receives a very emotional DVD sent by a dying woman to her husband (Golding). With only the clues from the DVD as her guide, she sets out to find him. Related Stories News Shawn Levy Moves To Disney's 20th Television With Overall Deal After Long Tenure At Netflix News 'La Bola Negra' Trailer: Latest Look At TIFF's People's Choice Winner, Spain's Oscar Entry & Cannes Breakout Olivia Krevoy, Jimmy Townsend, and Galen Fletcher executive produce the film. Watch on Deadline Both Lohan and Golding have found great success working on projects within the romance genre. Lohan’s credits include Just My Luck (2006), Falling for Christmas (2022), Irish Wish (2024) and Our Little Secret (2024). Golding was the leading man of the hugely popular Crazy Rich Asians (2018), Last Christmas (2019), Monsoon (2020), and Daniela Forever (2024). Lohan made her feature film debut in 1998 with Walt Disney Pictures’ The Parent Trap , which she followed with roles in Disney projects such as Life-Size , Get a Clue , Confessions of a Teenage Drama Queen , and most famously, starring opposite Jamie Lee Curtis in Freaky Friday . She recently reprised her Freaky Friday role in the sequel Freakier Friday (2025). One of her biggest roles to date is playing Cady Heron in the hugely popular teen comedy Mean Girls . Up next, she will star in and executive produce Hulu’s highly anticipated limited drama series, Count My Lies , adapted from Sophia Stava’s bestselling novel. Lohan is repped by IAG and attorney Dave Feldman. Golding can most recently be seen in the second season of Hulu’s Nine Perfect Strangers , Another Simple Favor for Amazon MGM Studios, and Old Guard 2 for Netflix. Additional film credits include Snake Eyes, A Simple Favor, The Ministry of Ungentlemanly Warfare, and Persuasion. On the series side, Golding can be seen in Guy Ritchie’s The Gentlemen for Netflix. He is repped by CAA, Megan Silverman Management, and Goodman, Genow. Champs is repped by Fourthwall Management. Champnella is repped by IAG and Dave Feldman. articles.title: Comedian Chris Hardwick Going Back To ‘The Middle Ages’ In Third Stand-Up Special
articles.full_text: Continue to Deadline SKIP AD You will be redirected back to your article in seconds Skip to main content By Matt Grobar Matt Grobar Senior Film Reporter More Stories By Matt ‘Landman’ Star James Jordan Joins Neon’s ‘They Follow’ Tom Segura Sets Preposterous Stand-Up Tour For 2027 Mind-Reading Comedian Peter Antoniou Sets 2027 Tour View All September 28, 2026 10:00am EXCLUSIVE: Comedian Chris Hardwick has announced that The Middle Ages — his third stand-up special and first in a decade — will premiere on Gorilla Comedy+ on October 5. It’ll then be unveiled on 800 Pound Gorilla’s YouTube channel at 7 p.m. CT. on October 20. In The Middle Ages , Hardwick takes on middle age, marriage, fatherhood and a rapidly changing world. Now in his 50s, he finds comedy in the indignities of aging, from growing pill collections and questionable digestive choices to prostate exams and realizing Gen Z are “time millionaires.” Check out a trailer above. Watch on Deadline Related Stories Touring Tom Segura Sets Preposterous Stand-Up Tour For 2027 Touring Mind-Reading Comedian Peter Antoniou Sets 2027 Tour “The foundation of this set came from my 2019/2020 tour with the intent to shoot the special in 2021, but the pandemic had other plans!” Hardwick told Deadline. “In January of 2022 we had a baby and I paused work stuff for what ultimately became a three-year hiatus. BUT in that time, I learned piano, became a parent and got even MORE middle-aged than I was before, so in a weird way the delay actually kind of helped the set, and I’m super excited it’s finally happening! HUGE thanks to 800 Pound Gorilla, who not only have built a fantastic comedy community but who’ve also been an absolute dream to work with.” Hardwick has worked in every sect of comedy, from the stand-up stage, to acting and writing in television and film, to voiceover work and hosting various podcasts and talk shows such as @midnight and Talking Dead . His previous hour specials, 2012’s Mandroid and 2016’s Funcomfortable , aired on Comedy Central. This summer, he returned to podcasting with I Think You’re Overthinking It , a weekly chat show with AMC+ that marks the latest incarnation of his former longtime pod The Nerdist Podcast . He also exec produces and hosts NBC’s The Wall , which this year was nominated for a Critics Choice Real TV Award for Best Game Show. He is repped by UTA, Brillstein Entertainment Partners, and Goodman, Genow, Schenkman. This story originated as part of Deadline’s Comedy Means Business

articles.title: ‘Resident Evil’ Producer Carter Swan Developing Keenspot Comic Book ‘The Crying Boy’ For Film
articles.full_text: Continue to Deadline SKIP AD You will be redirected back to your article in seconds Skip to main content By Matt Grobar Matt Grobar Senior Film Reporter More Stories By Matt ‘Landman’ Star James Jordan Joins Neon’s ‘They Follow’ Tom Segura Sets Preposterous Stand-Up Tour For 2027 Mind-Reading Comedian Peter Antoniou Sets 2027 Tour View All September 28, 2026 10:12am 'The Crying Boy,' Carter Swan Gilbert Flores/PMC EXCLUSIVE: As Zach Cregger’s Resident Evil prepares to cross $200M at the worldwide box office, the film’s producer Carter Swan has a new project to announce — a film adaptation of the Keenspot comic book series The Crying Boy by Niall O’Rourke & Rob Moran. Published in 2024, The Crying Boy follows a grieving widow trying to rebuild her life in Queens after the violent death of her husband. Things take a turn for the worse when she must save her young son from an even more terrifying fate, when the haunting painting of a crying child that he eerily befriends proves to be the vessel for an ancient demon that has preyed on children for millennia. Related Stories News Kate Micucci Developing Animated Series 'Toy' Based On Keenspot Comic News Zero Gravity Management Signs Keenspot, Comics Creator Behind Hit Jennifer Lopez Pic 'Marry Me' Following a Ringo Award nomination for Best Single Issue or Short Story, The Crying Boy ‘s first issue is currently in its third printing, with a deluxe collection of the series planned for 2027 via Keenspot’s book distribution deal with Simon & Schuster. Rona Mark is scripting the big-screen adaptation. Watch on Deadline The comic’s co-creator O’Rourke said, “Super excited to work with Carter Swan and develop the project. He brings an incredible amount of experience and knowledge to this. We hit it off straight away after he read the script and he was a big fan of the Keenspot comic book series.” A senior producer at PlayStation Productions for nearly eight years — through end of 2025 — Swan worked on Cregger’s Resident Evil during his time there, as well as HBO’s The Last of Us , Uncharted , Gran Turismo , Twisted Metal and Until Dawn . As an executive producer on The Last of Us , he earned Emmy nominations in 2023 and ’25. For a time the world’s largest publisher of webcomics, Keenspot was founded in 2000. The company first broke into film with the Universal rom-com Marry Me — a 2022 adaptation of one of its webcomics starring Jennifer Lopez and Owen Wilson. The company’s first animated adaptation was Grubbs , based on the comics by Max Weaver, whose voice cast included Wil Wheaton, Jerry O’Connell, Jodie Sweetin and more. Presently, Keenspot is also developing the animated adaptations Toy starring Kate Micucci and Kung Fu Legume starring Sherry Cola and Kheng Hua Tan, among other projects. Chris Crosby, comic book publisher Keenspot’s CEO, said: “ The Crying Boy has been one of Keenspot’s best-received titles and we’re ecstatic that a producer like Swan will be helping to bring it to the big screen.
